newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Volvo sets share redemption price 257 Skr.
newsitem.headline: Volvo sets share redemption price 257 Skr.

text.p: Swedish automotive group AB Volvo said on Monday it had calculated the redemption amount for Volvo shares at 257 crowns per unit.
Volvo said in a statement that the final acceptance date for redemption of shares is June 11.
After all acceptances have been received, Volvo's board will report the total number of shares submitted for redemption.

It will propose to a special general meeting on June 26 to reduce the share capital through redemption of shares, proceed with a bonus issue and make the relevant changes to the Articles of Association.

Volvo said the redemption amount was computed as the average share price for three days on the Stockholm Stock Exchange during the period May 13 to June 6 when Volvo's B-series share reached its highest volume-based average paid price.
This was rounded upwards to the next whole crown with a supplementary premium of 40 crowns.
Volvo announced in March that it would redeem one in every 20 shares, or a maximum of five percent of the total number, at 40 crowns above the market price.
If the redemption is fully exercised, the number of Volvo shares will decline to 441 million from 463.6 million, the company said earlier.
Payment of the redemption amount is expected to take place on July 10, Volvo said.
At 0855 GMT, Volvo shares were trading two crowns higher at 208.5 crowns.
